result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but several horizontally scrolling elements look visibly cut off at the right edge, and the lower restaurant card is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled chip at the right edge, which can look like accidental horizontal clipping rather than an intentional carousel continuation.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, such as consistent partial-card spacing, a fade/gradient edge, or a visible next chip label.

issues.description: In the “Fastest near you” row, the third restaurant card is clipped by the viewport, including its restaurant name and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer carousel treatment or adjust card sizing/spacing so the visible portion does not expose truncated content.

issues.description: The next “Popular right now” restaurant card is partially hidden underneath the fixed bottom navigation, making the visible content appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrollable page has sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset so the final content can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
